solidcore

solidcore is a Rust port of NVIDIA's SMLib, the boundary-representation (B-rep) solid modeling kernel from usd-brep (Apache-2.0), written in safe Rust: no unsafe, no panics on bad input, deterministic, and buildable for WebAssembly. The upstream code is split into 261 port units. A unit only counts as green when the difftest gate runs the Rust and the upstream C++ (through FFI) on the same inputs (upstream tests, fixtures and fixed-seed generated cases) and the topology is identical and every value agrees within 1e-9 relative. A partial unit passes every case it can run; its other cases are deferred because they reach code that is not ported yet. This page is regenerated from the repository on every push to main.
